standard_prerequisites: Unital ring homomorphisms satisfy phi(1) = 1; a nonzero ring has 1 not equal to 0; nonzero elements of a field are invertible
core_obligations: If a nonzero element a of F lies in the kernel, its inverse a^-1 maps to some element of R and phi(1) = phi(a^-1 a) = phi(a^-1) phi(a) = 0
But 1 = phi(1) = 0 forces R to be the zero ring, contradicting the hypothesis; hence the kernel is trivial and phi is injective
proof_roadmap: Read the contradiction off the image of 1
